name: GenCreator

avatar.who: Expert creator with a trusted body of work who wants a week of content that still sounds like them
jobs: turn one trusted source into a content constellation
avatar.sophistication: medium-high; protective of voice and credibility

notes: Public copy for GenCreator must not reference Oracle; tasks below avoid it.

tasks.prompt:
Source [S1]: 'Most creators fail at consistency, not ideas. I batch-record on Mondays, then cut one long video into five clips. My rule: never post a clip I would not watch twice.'
Source [S2]: 'I stopped chasing trends in 2024. My audience grew slower but churned less.'
Write 3 LinkedIn posts (each 60-120 words) in the author's first-person voice. Every factual claim must end with its source tag [S1] or [S2]. Do not add statistics or claims not in the sources. Separate posts with a line containing only ---.
tasks.rubric: Which set sounds more like one real person wrote it from these sources: specific, varied openings, no invented facts, no guru tone?

tasks.prompt: From source [S1] 'I batch-record on Mondays, then cut one long video into five clips', write 5 short-video hooks (max 12 words each) as a numbered list 1-5. No questions that start with 'Did you know'. No emoji.
tasks.rubric: Which hooks would stop a scroll without clickbait, while staying true to the source?

tasks.prompt: Review this draft post against its source and return JSON with keys verdict ('approve' or 'revise'), unsupported_claims (array of strings), voice_issues (array of strings). Source [S1]: 'I batch-record on Mondays.' Draft: 'Batching on Mondays tripled my output and 80% of top creators do the same [S1]. Unlock your potential today!'
tasks.rubric: Which review catches every unsupported claim and the voice problem without inventing issues?
